caseNameFull: Southeastern Greyhound Lines v. McCanless, Commissioner of Finance and Taxation
attorneys: (1) Maurer v. Hamilton, 309 U. S. 598; (2) Clark v. Paul Gray, Inc., 306 U. S. 583, 598-600. Mr. Charles C. Trabue, Jr. for appellants. Mr. W. F. Barry, Jr. for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.
